disabilities.condition.blind.you: You only see a couple of blocks. Sounds leave a visible echo; tap the white cane (right click) to see around you for a moment.
disabilities.condition.blind.others: Dark glasses and a white cane tapping the ground.
disabilities.condition.achromatopsia.you: Everything is black and white, inventory included: diamonds, emeralds and redstone look alike.
disabilities.condition.myopia.you: Anything more than a few blocks away is a blur.
disabilities.condition.one_eye.you: Half of the screen is dark.
disabilities.condition.albinism.you: Sunlight blinds and burns you: outdoors by day you need a helmet.
disabilities.condition.albinism.others: Very pale skin, smoking when you burn.
disabilities.condition.deaf.you: You hear no sound at all.
disabilities.condition.mute.you: You cannot chat: you talk with gestures (G key).
disabilities.condition.mute.others: They see your gestures and a bubble with their meaning.
disabilities.condition.dyslexia.you: Every letter on screen is jumbled.
disabilities.condition.dyslexia.others: Your chat messages arrive with swapped letters.
disabilities.condition.wheelchair.you: You are in a wheelchair: no jumping, no ladders; to go up you need stairs or slabs.
disabilities.condition.wheelchair.others: They see you sitting in your wheelchair.
disabilities.condition.one_leg.you: You walk on crutches: slower, no sprinting, short jumps; you must stop to use your hands.
disabilities.condition.one_arm.you: No off hand, no bows, crossbows or tridents; you mine slower.
disabilities.condition.dwarfism.you: You are tiny: shorter reach and slower walking.
disabilities.condition.obesity.you: Slower, twice as hungry, out of breath after a short run, falls hurt more. But you are hard to push around.
disabilities.condition.obesity.others: A huge body and heavy panting.
disabilities.condition.parkinson.you: Your aim always shakes, sometimes you freeze, and now and then things slip from your hand.
disabilities.condition.narcolepsy.you: You suddenly fall asleep for a few seconds, also when startled. A friend can wake you with a right click.
disabilities.condition.tourette.you: Sudden tics: head jerks, jumps, punches at the air, noises and random words.
disabilities.condition.tourette.others: They see the tics, hear the noises and read the words in chat.
disabilities.condition.amnesia.you: No F3 and no recipe book, you forget the others' names and now and then your inventory gets shuffled.
disabilities.condition.amnesia.others: Question marks above your head when you forget.
disabilities.condition.vertigo.you: The world sways, everything spins near drops, and now and then you stumble.
disabilities.condition.vertigo.others: They see you sway and stumble.
disabilities.condition.asthma.you: Running and jumping take your breath away, and without breath you slow down. You have an inhaler.
disabilities.condition.hemophilia.you: Every wound keeps bleeding until you use a bandage.
disabilities.condition.allergy.you: Near flowers, grass and animals you sneeze: you jerk, your eyes water and sometimes you drop what you hold.
